=== data-structures ===
[build-system]
requires = [
    "setuptools",
]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[project]
name = "demospipes_data_structures"
version = "1.0.3"
description = "Shared data structures for the demospipes API and core."
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.12"
keywords = [
    "demos",
    "demospipes",
]
classifiers = [
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3",
]
dependencies = [
    "pydantic~=2.13.4",
]

[dependency-groups]
dev = [
    "ruff>=0.14.0",
    "pylint>=3.3.0",
    "bandit[toml]>=1.8.0",
    "mypy>=1.18.0",
]
test = [
    "pytest>=9.1.0",
    "pytest-cov>=7.1.0",
]

[tool.setuptools.packages.find]
where = [
    "src",
]

observation.command: cd /workspace && sed -n '1,60p' 02-backend/demospipes/core/pyproject.toml | grep -n "name\|version\|path"; echo "=== data-structures ==="; cat 02-backend/demospipes/data-structures/pyproject.toml | head -40
